name: Masistant
author: Masiou

sections.description:
Masistant is a chat panel inside your WordPress admin. You tell it what you want — in plain English or Greek — and it does it on your site through capability-checked tools: content, products, orders, coupons, SEO meta, media, menus and whitelisted settings. By default, every change shows an approval card before it runs; every action is logged, and changes are recorded so they can be taken back.

How the AI is provided. Masistant does not bundle an AI model. Under Masistant → Settings → AI provider you choose where it comes from: the Masiou service (masiou.ai), where a free account gives you a license key for the free plan — the conversation with the WordPress and WooCommerce tools on one site, with a small monthly allowance — and paid plans (from €10 a month) add a larger allowance and services that run on the Masiou cloud: Masiou Studio (a hosted writing pipeline for articles and product copy), AI image generation, product image search, Boost and AI Visibility. Everything the plugin does on your site itself, writing and editing content included, works on every plan; or the WordPress AI Client (WordPress 7.0 or newer): the AI provider you connected yourself under Settings → Connectors, with no Masiou account. Through the AI Client the conversation and every site tool work the same; Masiou Studio, AI images, product image search, Boost and AI Visibility are services of Masiou and exist only with the Masiou service. Details and prices: https://masiou.ai/admin-ai/

What it does

  • Content: posts and pages created as native Gutenberg blocks, edits of single fields, find-and-replace inside a post, publish / schedule / trash (never permanent deletion), categories, tags, comments.
  • Page builders: understands how a page is built — block editor, classic editor, Elementor, WPBakery, Divi, Avada, Beaver Builder, Bricks, SiteOrigin, Thrive Architect — and edits its texts in place (headings, paragraphs, buttons, list items, link URLs) without touching the layout or design, with Undo. Headers, footers, popups, templates and widget areas are found as their own documents and edited there.
  • WooCommerce: product search by text, SKU, category, brand, attribute, price, stock or what a product is missing; products and variations; variation prices in one approval; bulk price changes with a preview; stock in bulk; low stock; orders, order status and notes; coupons; customers; sales reports; sales by channel (order attribution); the full category tree and brands; a completeness audit of products with a score. HPOS compatible.
  • Cross-sells and upsells: suggestions for one product, a category or the whole catalogue, shown as product cards, applied with a dry run and an approval card.
  • SEO: reads and writes the SEO title, meta description, focus keyword and noindex of Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress; finds pages without meta; a site-wide SEO audit with a score, issues and fixes.
  • Media: search, alt text, captions, featured images, images without alt, saving an image you attach to the chat.
  • Site: settings (whitelisted), menus, caches of the common caching plugins, site health, the list of installed plugins and of users (read-only).
  • Masiou Studio (a service of the Masiou cloud, paid plans): complete SEO articles with your own products recommended inside, product copy written from the product’s data, AI images for banners, hero images and social posts (never photos of real products).
  • AI Visibility (a service of the Masiou cloud, Standard plan and up): how ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini answer your customers’ shopping questions — whether they cite your store, mention it or send the shopper to a competitor — with a score, a competitor table and a written action plan.
  • Safety net: approval cards (the default setting), Undo for recorded changes, nothing deleted permanently, no plugin or theme installed, activated or deactivated, no user accounts created or changed, no files edited, no code executed. Each tool runs strictly with the WordPress capabilities of the logged-in user.
  • Also: attach images or dictate with the microphone; a Stop button; page-aware suggestions; Greek and English.

Visitors load nothing of the plugin: on the front end only logged-in users with the toolbar get the assistant. Masistant is independent from the Masiou Chat visitor widget.

Which servers the plugin talks to, what it sends them and when is listed in full under “External services” below.

External services

Masistant does not bundle an AI model. It needs one external AI service, which you choose under Masistant → Settings → AI provider. Until you enter a license key or select a provider, the plugin contacts no server.

1. The Masiou service (default)

Operated by Masiou (masiou.ai). Its API answers at https://api.masiou.com, with https://chat.masiou.com as a fallback, both over TLS. It runs the AI model for the conversation, meters the allowance of your plan and validates your license key. It is contacted only while “Masiou service” is the selected provider and a license key is stored.

What is sent, and when:

  • When you activate, refresh or remove the license key, and once a day in the background (WP-Cron) while a key is stored: the license key, the site URL and name, the plugin and WordPress versions. The answer carries your plan and its usage.
  • When you send a message in the chat: your message and the conversation so far; the assistant’s instructions, which describe the site (site name and URL, WordPress and WooCommerce versions, theme name, language, timezone, currency, the active SEO plugin and page builders, your display name and role, your own custom instructions); the admin screen you are on (its name; the title, type and status of the item you have open; text you selected in the editor); the list of tools; the results of the tools the answer needs (for example the products or orders you asked about); and the images you attach. E-mail addresses, phone numbers and IBANs in tool results are masked before sending (the default; Settings → Security & data), and passwords, keys, tokens and nonces are removed.
  • When a Masiou Studio tool runs (articles, product copy, AI images; paid plans): the topic and keywords, the products it may recommend (name, URL, price, short text), category names, the site name and tagline; for product copy the product’s own data; for an AI image the description of the image.
  • When you search product images or create a product from a code (paid plans): the product’s name, SKU / MPN / GTIN, brand and colour, or the code you typed, with your category names so the product can be filed.
  • When cross-sells are suggested with the “masiou” strategy: the names of your product categories and the store name. The “local” strategy sends nothing.
  • When you run AI Visibility or the AI readiness check: the shopping questions you approved, the store name, its public domain(s) and the language. For the readiness check the service then requests your public home page, robots.txt and llms.txt from its own servers, identifying as the AI crawlers, to see whether they are let in.

What is never sent: passwords, application passwords, wp-config.php, server files, the database as such, payment details.

What the service stores: per license, usage counters (calls, tokens, cost, status) and the AI Visibility runs you started. It does not store the content of conversations: they stay in your own WordPress database, with the activity log.

Who processes the data for the service: the conversation, the Studio texts and the AI images are processed with OpenAI’s API on Masiou’s behalf (OpenAI does not train its models on API data); AI Visibility puts your questions to ChatGPT (OpenAI), Perplexity and Gemini (Google); product image search uses Google Images through a search API provider. The plugin itself never contacts these companies.

Terms of use: https://masiou.ai/terms-of-use/ · Privacy policy: https://masiou.ai/privacy-policy/

2. The WordPress AI Client (optional, WordPress 7.0 or newer)

With “WordPress AI Client” selected, the chat data listed above under “When you send a message” goes, through WordPress’s own AI Client, to the AI provider you connected in WordPress under Settings → Connectors, under that provider’s own terms and privacy policy. The plugin holds no key for it. In this mode the plugin does not contact the Masiou service: the tools that run on it are not offered, and the daily status check does not run.

3. What your site and your browser fetch at your request

  • “Upload media from URL” and “Set product images” download the exact public image URLs you provide (or the image-search results you picked) into your media library.
  • Image-search results are shown in the chat as thumbnails that your browser loads from the sites they come from (shops, brands, the search engine’s image cache). No referrer is sent to them.
  • Dictation (the microphone button) uses your browser’s built-in speech recognition. In Chrome-based browsers and Safari the audio is processed by the browser vendor’s speech service; nothing of it passes through the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory (Plugins → Add New → search “Masistant”) or upload the masistant folder to /wp-content/plugins/, then activate it.
  2. Either create a free account at https://masiou.ai/admin-ai/ and copy the license key from your account page (it is also in the welcome email), or — on WordPress 7.0 or newer — connect an AI provider of your own under Settings → Connectors and choose “WordPress AI Client” under Masistant → Settings → AI provider.
  3. With a Masiou key: go to Masistant → Settings → Subscription, paste it and click Activate. One key works on one site; activating it on another site moves it there.
  4. Open Masistant from the admin bar (Alt+M) or from Masistant → Chat.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account or an API key with an AI company?

Not necessarily. With the Masiou service the only thing you enter is the license key from your Masiou account, and a free plan exists. If you would rather use your own AI provider, WordPress 7.0 and newer let you connect one under Settings → Connectors, and Masistant can run on it with no Masiou account.

What does the free plan include?

The conversation with all the WordPress and WooCommerce tools (content, products, orders, SEO meta, media, menus, settings), the approval cards, Undo and the activity log, on one site, with a small monthly allowance. Writing and editing posts, pages and product texts with these tools works on every plan. What the paid plans add are services that run on the Masiou cloud: Masiou Studio (a hosted writing pipeline), AI image generation, product image search, Boost (stronger models) and AI Visibility runs.

Can it change something on my site without me knowing?

Not with the default settings. By default every change shows an approval card before it runs. Under Masistant → Settings → Behaviour you can limit the cards to destructive changes, or turn them off (“Never ask”). Read-only actions run immediately. Every action is logged with user, time and result, and recorded changes can be taken back from the chat or from Activity log → Changes.

Which users can use it?

Administrators by default. You can allow other roles (for example Shop Manager). Each user works strictly with their own WordPress capabilities — the assistant never bypasses them.

Can anything outside my logged-in session use the assistant?

No. The assistant works only in your own logged-in session — in wp-admin and, unless you switch that off under Settings → Behaviour, in the bar that logged-in users with the toolbar see on the site itself. Its REST routes answer only to an authenticated WordPress user whose role is allowed to use the assistant (administrators by default). It does not edit code (raw HTML, JavaScript or CSS elements are left alone, and find-and-replace skips them; everything the assistant writes passes through WordPress’s own HTML filter), it does not install, activate or deactivate plugins or themes, and it does not create or change user accounts.

What happens to my data?

What the request needs is sent to the AI service you chose, at the moment of the request, with e-mail addresses, phone numbers and IBANs in tool results masked by default. Conversations and the activity log stay in your WordPress database. The full list of what is sent, to whom and when is under “External services”.

What happens when the monthly allowance is used up?

At 90% you get a warning. At 100% the assistant pauses until the first of the next month — or continues immediately if you upgrade your plan from your Masiou account. There are no hidden charges.

On how many sites can I use one key?

One. You can move the key to another site at any time (the previous site is deactivated). For several sites you need one subscription per site.

Is it compatible with my setup?

WordPress 6.2+, PHP 7.4+, multisite, WooCommerce (including HPOS), Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, the block editor and the page builders listed above. The plugin loads nothing on visitor pages.

Does it work with page builders?

It reads pages built with the block editor, the classic editor, Elementor, WPBakery, Divi, Avada, Beaver Builder, Bricks, SiteOrigin, Thrive Architect, Oxygen, Brizy, Breakdance, Cornerstone, Zion, Themify, Visual Composer Website Builder and Live Composer, and edits texts in place for the first ten; the others are changed in their own editor.
sections.changelog:
1.20.4

  • Plans decide only which services of the Masiou cloud a site can call. The assistant is never told to refuse or cut short work the tools on the site can do: on the Free plan it writes articles, pages and product texts itself with the content and product tools.
  • With the WordPress AI Client selected the plugin does not contact the Masiou service at all: the tools that run on it are not offered, and the daily status check does not run.
  • No code by any route: a call whose text carries a code shortcode (a page builder’s raw JavaScript / raw HTML element, a snippet runner), a shortcode attribute with CSS or a click handler, or a builder’s encoded HTML value is refused; whatever a tool saves is checked again on its way into the database, so code cannot be assembled from several edits either; titles are text; text that spells out a tag with entities stays text; the Additional CSS, global styles, Customizer changesets and snippet post types are not written; “Upload media from URL” saves only real images and PDFs. Code the site owner placed is left untouched.
  • Rights as in wp-admin: a status is published, scheduled or private only with the post type’s right to publish (posts, pages, products, coupons, and when Undo puts a status back); another author only with the right to edit others’ items; new attribute values and brands only with the taxonomy’s right; bulk price changes only on products the user may edit; replies only on posts the user may edit; other users’ drafts, private items and internal post types are neither listed nor read; versions, pending updates and account counts are shown to administrators only.
  • Settings and the first screens say where the AI can come from (a free Masiou account or your own provider); tools that run on the Masiou service carry a neutral “Masiou service” label instead of a plan badge; the bar on admin screens appears once the assistant is set up.
  • Uninstall removes only the plugin’s own options, transients and tables.
  • readme: the External services section lists every server, every kind of data and every moment it is sent.

screenshots.caption: The chat panel on the dashboard, with page-aware suggestions.
Product cards in the chat: a WooCommerce search with images, prices and stock.
An approval card: with the default setting, nothing changes before you approve it.
Settings → AI provider: the Masiou service, or the AI provider you connected in WordPress (WordPress AI Client).
Settings → Tools: the tool groups and each tool, with its risk and the capability it needs; each one can be switched off.
Settings → Behaviour: by default every change shows an approval card; you can limit the cards to destructive changes or turn them off.
